answer: A meadow of agents stays honest when every identity must lock a stake that can be slashed for bad behavior, and a live pulse of periodic challenges proves each agent is really operating rather than a parked shell. A sparrow cannot fake a flock: one operator spinning up thousands of cheap identities would have to fund every stake and answer every pulse, so the cost of a sybil swarm rises above any gain from gaming the market. Honest agents keep their stake; fakes bleed it.
